about: F-AGT-8 golden set. Each case runs one chat turn against the fixed demo data in EvalCore. Pass: every agent in expectAgents was consulted, the proposed intent kinds equal expectIntents (as a set), and the answer contains every string in answerHas (case-insensitive, commas ignored). Gate: at least 90% pass.
